title: Therapy Intake Form
subtitle: Capture presenting concern, patient goal, referral, and accessibility; confirm clinician review and care handoff.
description: Therapy Intake records presenting concern, patient goal, referral, accessibility, clinician review, and care handoff. Therapy Intake evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this therapy intake structured intake when staff must document presenting concern and patient goal. Reconcile referral, accessibility, clinician review, and care handoff before the therapy intake handoff. Use the patient narrative, referral documents, accessibility request, urgent-concern routing, clinician questions, modality preference, scheduling handoff, and receipt confirmation. This intake preserves the person's presenting narrative, counseling goals, referral context, communication access, urgent routing, clinician questions, modality preference, and first-session handoff. Keep self-described stressors, strengths, supports, prior service context, language preference, sensory or mobility access, immediate resource needs, screening provenance, and intake disposition visible. Ask the assigned therapy intake reviewer to confirm presenting concern against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Therapy Intake contact and reference
sections.guidance: Capture presenting concern in patient words, desired outcome, referral context, accessibility and communication needs, clinician review questions, and care handoff. Keep any urgent therapy intake issue with its escalation contact and time.

sections.title: Therapy Intake exception review and reported needs
sections.guidance: Preserve the person's wording and route questions without interpretation.

blocks.label: Therapy Intake stated need or goal

fields.label: Person's words, desired outcome, and priority

blocks.label: Therapy Intake readiness
items: Presenting concern is identified for this record
Patient goal matches the current request or source
Referral is ready for point-of-use staff
Accessibility limits or questions are resolved
Clinician review is communicated to the responsible person
Care handoff is confirmed at handoff

sections.title: Therapy Intake receiving route
sections.guidance: Assign open questions and confirm where the intake goes next.

blocks.label: Therapy Intake receipt
blocks.guidance: Receipt confirms routing, not professional review.
